seed_ledger.name: Project Hummingbird power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source names the pipeline or lateral. The September 2026 Herald-Standard report still says two on-site turbines totaling 910 MW. Essential Utilities (Peoples) is a gas and water partner and its release says backup comes from an existing grid interconnection. Local gas supply is cited as a site advantage. Columbia (0.4 km) and Equitrans (3.3 km) are close, so a tap is plausible but unsourced. Greene County planning commission page and DEP air permit search gave no supply detail. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: EIA workbook and FERC not found naming the plant; state regulator and air permit records; local news; developer and utility releases; trade press.

evidence.note: Sept 2026: two turbines, 910 MW, no gas supply pipe named

seed_ledger.name: TECfusions Keystone Connect power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: TECfusions says it will burn gas from wells and a gas-drying plant already on the former Alcoa site, with about 280 MW from West Penn Power. That points to on-site or in-fence supply, but no source describes a tap or new pipe, and no DEP permit for the plant was found. Nearest GGIT line is the Eastern Gas main line at 5.1 km, unsourced.
